title: SemanticConcepts
description: The weighted concept capture behind the dashboard word cloud (output/dashboard/semantic-concepts.json): a paid model reading of the whole projected corpus, staged to cache/dashboard and validated against this schema before promotion (dashboard.sh, in-memory via validate.py — no per-datum matrix, the markdownConversation precedent). v2 adds the provider column: each concept is tagged with the provider(s) it is salient in, captured in the same single reading, so the dashboard's provider toggle can filter the cloud client-side. Two consumers, each taking what it needs: the dashboard uses the weights and tags (cloud sizing and filtering); indexing borrows only the names (candidate headwords).

SemanticConcepts.title: SemanticConcepts
SemanticConcepts.description: A format_table-styled three-column table: the concept names, their salience weights, and their provider tags.

rows.description: At least one concept — an empty capture is a failed capture.

ConceptRow.title: ConceptRow
ConceptRow.description: One concept: [word, count, provider]. The count is SALIENCE, not raw frequency — the model scales the top concept to 100. The provider names where the concept is salient: one provider's conversations, or both.

items.description: Key concept or theme (word or short phrase).
Which provider the concept is salient in. The set is exhaustive: the corpus's two providers plus "both"; a third provider would mint a new schema version.
